This is a local FastAPI application that manages persistent domain resources through REST endpoints.
Apply the shared authorization, validation, controlled-error, and transaction conventions specified for the endpoint.

requirement_context.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /owners to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON full_name, email, optional phone, and for an admin only optional positive account_id; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-3-001 and REQ-3-002, require a supplied account_id to identify an existing account, assign a user-created profile to the caller account, atomically create the profile, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

endpoint_pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleCreateOwner(request):
    // REQ-3-013; preconditions: JSON request and local persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401. REQUIRE application/json OR RETURN 415.
    VALIDATE body under REQ-3-001 and REQ-3-002 OR RETURN 400 or 422; users must not supply another account_id OR RETURN 403; unknown supplied account_id is 404.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION. IF caller already has an active owner profile OR normalized email exists THEN ROLLBACK; RETURN 409. END IF
    CREATE owner mapped to caller or requested existing account; COMMIT; RETURN 201 with Location.
    // Non-idempotent. On every error rollback leaves owners and all relationships unchanged.

relevant_domain_invariants.requirement: Owner, animal, and ownership ids are immutable positive integers; a non-positive path or referenced id is treated as not found. All persisted dates use ISO-8601 calendar dates in the inclusive range 1900-01-01 through 2100-12-31.

An owner has full_name after trimming of 3..120 characters, normalized lowercase email of 5..254 characters matching a conventional local@domain form, and optional phone of 7..25 characters containing only digits, spaces, plus signs, hyphens, and parentheses. A non-deleted owner email is unique.
